messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@launchpad.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchPad MAP kickoff — executive sponsor intro & Q4 close cadence

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align stakeholders, evaluation criteria, and a clear path to close this quarter.

Attached: a working MAP draft (LaunchPad_MAP_v1.docx) and a suggested evaluation criteria sheet. High-level asks from my side:
- Executive sponsor: would be helpful to have a VP/CTO-level sponsor who can unblock policy/ops decisions and sign off on outcomes.
- Technical sponsor: a senior engineering contact to coordinate the eval and scale testing.
- Timeline: target contractual close and pilot start by end of Q4 (by 2027-12-15).

Suggested kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & roles (exec sponsor, technical sponsor, Redwood owner)
2) Acceptance criteria for evaluation (latency/cost SLOs, data handling)
3) Pilot scope + success metrics and timeline
4) Escalation path for procurement/security redlines

Proposed times for a kickoff call next week: Tue 10/5 10–11am PT or Wed 10/6 2–3pm PT. Let me know what works.

I looped in Laura (Sales Ops) and Karthik (solutions) from our side; Priyom will own MAP milestones and rollout coordination.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: LaunchPad_MAP_v1.docx; LaunchPad_EvalCriteria_Q42027.xlsx

Subject: Re: LaunchPad MAP kickoff — executive sponsor intro & Q4 close cadence

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan. Happy to move forward. Per internal alignment here, I'm introducing two folks who should be on the MAP thread:
- Nora Singh <nora.singh@launchpad.ai>, our CTO — we'd like her to be the executive sponsor for the evaluation.
- Rajesh Menon <rajesh.m@launchpad.ai>, VP Engineering — will act as technical sponsor for lab testing and performance signoff.

Nora and Rajesh, Ben has shared a draft MAP and an eval template. Our priorities are straightforward: fast performance verification under our peak prompts, clear data controls, and a procurement path that avoids month-long legal cycles.

I can do Tue 10/5 10:00 PT. If that works, please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor | Head of Partnerships
LaunchPad AI

Nora / Rajesh —

Great to e-meet you both, and thanks Liam for the intro. A few items to make the MAP concrete before the kickoff on Tue 10/5 10:00 PT:

1) Proposed exec & tech roles (to confirm)
   - Exec sponsor: Nora Singh (CTO, LaunchPad) — high-level acceptance and procurement escalation
   - Technical sponsor: Rajesh Menon (VP Eng, LaunchPad) — owns lab test schedule and performance signoff
   - Redwood executive touchpoint for escalations: Rishi Malhotra (SVP, Product & Ops) — contact for any cross-org unblock or SLA exceptions
   - Redwood delivery leads: Karthik Iyer (Solutions), Priyom Das (MAP PM)

2) Draft MAP milestones (owner, date):
   - Week 0 (10/5): Kickoff + finalize acceptance criteria — owners: all exec/tech sponsors
   - Week 1–2: Sandbox perf run + integrations (Karthik / Rajesh)
   - Week 3: Evaluation signoff (metrics pass/fail) and commercial review (Ben/Laura)
   - Week 6: Pilot start if signoff complete (Priyom lead)

3) Escalation path (quick reference):
   - Technical issues (performance/regression): Rajesh -> Karthik -> Redwood SE leads
   - Security/compliance blockers: Laura (Sales Ops) -> Rishi -> Redwood Security
   - Contract/legal: Laura -> Redwood Legal -> LaunchPad Procurement (Liam)

4) Success criteria (examples)
   - API 95th p50 latency < 350ms for 512-token requests under 50 RPS load
   - Embedding recall >= 0.88 on the provided eval set
   - Data handling: KV cache transient, no customer data retention beyond session unless agreed

I attached an updated MAP with the milestones populated and a short escalation matrix (Redwood_ExecEscalationMatrix.pdf). Also included an evaluation spreadsheet for you to edit ahead of the kickoff.

If the roles and milestones look correct, we'll finalize the invite and include a short pre-read (1–2 pages). Ben and I can own the quarter-close timeline and provide a rolling status each week.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks — Nora here. Happy to serve as LaunchPad's executive sponsor. Quick notes before the kickoff:
- Outcome-oriented request: we need a clear go/no-go signal by 11/30 so procurement can accelerate for a Dec pilot.
- Primary non-negotiables: demonstrable isolation of customer data, and a remediation plan for any security exceptions.
- If the evaluation discovers a regression in generation quality, Rajesh will decide if we pause; if that decision needs escalation, please route to Rishi.

We can confirm Tue 10/5 10:00 PT; I've asked my EA to add a 30-minute slot. I'll bring a short set of business outcomes to the call (top-line ROI assumptions and expected Q1 metrics).

See you Tuesday.

—Nora
